title: Redis: cluster topology + slot map
description: Runs `nexus topology redis` to surface the 3-shard topology with slot ranges + primary/replica pairing per shard. --watch redraws every 2s -- useful while observing a failover or rebalance.

observe.what: 3 shards: each row is { ShardId, Primary, Replicas[], SlotRange }; slot ranges should sum to 16384 across shards

whatProves: RedisAdapter's TopologyAsync correctly stitches slot ranges from CLUSTER NODES + pairs primaries with their replicas per shard.
